analysis.overall: The day featured a major morning spike reaching over 300 mg/dL following pump connectivity issues, which required aggressive stacking of corrections before stabilizing by midday.

events.title: Pump Connectivity Issues
events.description: Repeated 'pump unreachable' notifications interrupted automated delivery, allowing glucose to climb out of range.

events.title: Significant Morning Spike
events.description: Glucose peaked at 306 mg/dL due to missed delivery, leading to a long chain of micro-corrections over several hours.

events.title: Lunch Carb Intake
events.description: A 50g meal bolus was administered as glucose recovered, triggering a moderate secondary rise that was successfully reined in.

events.title: Rapid Descent
events.description: Aggressive correction stacking caught up, causing a steep drop of over 20 mg/dL every 5 minutes before leveling out near 130 mg/dL.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep a close eye on pump connectivity and site performance to prevent unexpected delivery gaps from triggering another major climb.
